stories.title: Prove every concurrent proposal is one set in a single response
stories.scope: Built set view: GET /proposals route + set assembly (platform/src/index.ts L1122; computeProposals ~L560-670 — one response carrying base/ref/proposals/conflicts/summary, artifacts auto-discovery agent-*) and the single-canvas render (platform/ui/app.js renderProposals/renderProposalsView; platform/ui/index.html #conflicts-section + #proposals-section, one grid, no pager). Evidence: live payload assertion + headless-Chrome --dump-dom of the real UI (platform/ui) served the live payload from a local fixture harness.
stories.acceptance: GET /proposals returns every auto-discovered proposal (agent-*) in one response: ok:true; keys exactly {base,conflicts,ok,proposals,ref,summary} (no paging cursor); every repo matches ^agent-*; summary.proposals == proposals.length. The UI renders the whole set at once: card count == proposals.length, every repo has its card, #proposals-meta reads exactly 'N active' (N = proposals.length), the conflict map section is present at rest with the modal still hidden, and no pagination/load-more/page-control artifacts exist. A set of N proposals renders as N cards — no route-level pagination and no collapse in v1.
stories.notes: Overlaps build-multiplayer-triage-canvas-with-proposal-artifacts [pending], ship-set-level-triage-of-n-concurrent-agent-change-sets-as-h [pending], support-host-git-or-native-proposal-model [pending] — those rows own the set-view build; this story proves the built behavior (live payload + real-UI DOM), no rebuild. platform/scripts/demo-verify.mjs remains the repo's live demo acceptance suite for the same set; this check re-issues only the FR-1-relevant subset standalone (fixture harness keeps it independent of /judge and demo mutability).

stories.title: Prove the proposal card anatomy and the secret-row treatment
stories.scope: Built card anatomy: platform/ui/app.js renderProposals (repo title .proposal-repo-title, intent .proposal-intent, stats block 'N files'/+a/-d, per-file .file-row with status indicator + path + counts + 'view diff', secret rows badge-secret + secret-key-tag with no diff action, at-rest actions .btn-preview-merge and [data-action=start-land]). Payload fields from platform/src/index.ts computeProposals (repo/intent/stats/files{path,status,additions,deletions,secret,keys}); secret-content law per platform/CONTRACT.md. Evidence: fixture-served DOM dump driven by the live payload.
stories.acceptance: For every proposal in the live set its card shows: repo name; the written intent when present (and no intent label when absent); stats exactly 'N files', '+a', '-d' matching the payload; one row per changed file with path + status + additions/deletions; at rest every non-landed card carries 'preview merge' and 'Land into demo'. Every non-secret file row carries 'view diff'; secret-class rows (demo fixture: agent-5 config/.env, keys DATABASE_URL/REDIS_URL) show the 'secret-typed' badge and their key names and offer no diff action — a secret row never exposes a diff path.
stories.notes: Overlaps proposal-card-signal-set-risk-provenance-fields-on-every-car [pending], complete-unified-proposal-card-intent-diff-risk-provenance [pending], build-multiplayer-triage-canvas-with-proposal-artifacts [pending] — those rows own card build (incl. risk/provenance facets); this story only verifies the built anatomy + secret-row masking, no rebuild. Judge risk/intent chips on cards are E5 territory (e5-verify-typed-signal-envelope) and are deliberately not asserted here.

stories.title: Prove the five summary chips are exact, tinted, and labeled
stories.scope: Built chips: platform/ui/index.html five .summary-chip values (#val-proposals/shared/conflicts/changed/clean); platform/ui/app.js renderHeader (counts + tint thresholds is-alert/is-warn/is-clean); set-level labels #conflicts-meta 'N detected' / #proposals-meta 'N active'; count math platform/src/index.ts computeProposals L660-667 (changedFiles = distinct file index, sharedFiles = conflict files, conflictingPairs/cleanPairs over pair.conflict). Evidence: jq recompute from the live payload + fixture-served DOM dump.
stories.acceptance: On the served /proposals payload the five chips show exactly the payload's five summary counts, and those counts independently recompute from the payload lists: proposals = proposals.length; sharedFiles = conflicts.length; conflictingPairs = pairs with conflict===true; cleanPairs = pairs with conflict===false; changedFiles = distinct changed file paths. Tints follow the thresholds exactly (is-alert iff conflictingPairs>0; is-warn iff sharedFiles>0; is-clean iff cleanPairs>0) and the labels are exact: 'N detected' and 'N active' — never approximate.
stories.notes: Overlaps build-multiplayer-triage-canvas-with-proposal-artifacts [pending] (count plumbing), compute-cross-change-conflict-graph-across-concurrent-change [pending], ship-set-level-triage-of-n-concurrent-agent-change-sets-as-h [pending] — build stays with those rows; this proves exactness against the live payload. The pre-payload placeholder state (chips as em-dash) is FR-7 work owned by E1-impl (e1-impl-chips-pending-placeholder) and is deliberately not asserted here.

stories.title: Prove the collision map renders every conflict with its evidence
stories.scope: Built collision map: platform/src/index.ts conflict construction (per-file kind/pairs with a/b/kind/conflict/region{baseLines,aLines,bLines}, KIND_SEVERITY worst kind per file, sorted by file) and platform/ui/app.js renderConflicts (per-file .conflict-card, .conflict-file, kind badge, severity classes severity-red/amber/neutral, .repo-tag list, .conflict-pair-row with 'a ↔ b' + pair kind + region text, read-only cards, meta 'N detected', empty-state copy). Evidence: fixture-served DOM dump with the live payload + a second dump with an empty-conflicts fixture.
stories.acceptance: For every conflicting pair in the live payload the map renders a per-file card: file path; the kind badge from the conflict-kinds enum; the involved repos; pair rows naming the two repos (a ↔ b) with their pair kind and base/line regions. Severity follows the kind mapping (hard kinds text-conflict/modify-delete/add-add red; undetermined amber; clean kinds neutral); cards are read-only (no buttons). #conflicts-meta reads exactly 'N detected' (N = conflicts.length); the map is visible at rest with no modal open. An empty set renders the explanatory empty state ('No convergence conflicts' + explanation), never a blank panel.
stories.notes: Overlaps visualize-the-cross-change-conflict-map-on-the-canvas [pending] and compute-cross-change-conflict-graph-across-concurrent-change [pending] — those rows own the map build; this verifies the built render (cards, severity mapping, regions, read-only) plus the empty state against the live set; no rebuild.

stories.title: Prove the default 8s refresh cycle and manual refresh
stories.scope: Built freshness cycle: platform/ui/app.js setupTimers (setInterval loadProposals 8000 guarded by state.autoRefresh; events 2000 unconditionally), auto-refresh toggle (#auto-refresh-toggle checked by default in platform/ui/index.html) and manual refresh (#btn-manual-refresh wiring). Evidence: instrumented real-UI run (fetch patched in-page before app.js init) against a fixture-serving local harness — poll timestamps, toggle-off window, manual click.
stories.acceptance: With auto-refresh on (default), /proposals refetches on a ~8s cycle after the initial load (consecutive fetch gap between 7000 and 9000 ms); switching the auto-refresh toggle off stops further /proposals polls (zero in a following 9s window) while the surface keeps the last payload; the manual 'refresh' control always triggers exactly one immediate /proposals fetch (verified with auto-refresh off), so a manual refresh is always available.
stories.notes: Overlaps ship-set-level-triage-of-n-concurrent-agent-change-sets-as-h [pending] and build-multiplayer-triage-canvas-with-proposal-artifacts [pending] (canvas/polling build); this story proves the built cadence and controls; no rebuild. Cache/scale work for the 20-50 proposal fleet (RUB:33) is a separate P2 item, untouched.

stories.title: Prove event debounce and land-triggered reload convergence
stories.scope: Built event-driven freshness: platform/ui/app.js loadEvents (top event key type:repo:at:after; key change → single debounced loadProposals after 500ms) and handleLandProposal (on success awaits loadProposals + loadEvents immediately, then re-renders). Evidence: instrumented real-UI run against a fixture harness whose /events flips its top event key on the second poll and whose /proposals returns the landed variant after /land.
stories.acceptance: A new top event key (from /events) triggers one debounced /proposals refresh ~500ms later (observed 300-1500 ms after the events response, well before the next 8s tick). A land immediately reloads both /proposals and /events (>=1 fetch each within the same interaction), and within that refresh cycle the landed proposal's card state matches the server: land-in-place means the card converges to its new server state (landed banner, 'landed — nothing pending').
stories.notes: Overlaps ship-set-level-triage-of-n-concurrent-agent-change-sets-as-h [pending] and build-multiplayer-triage-canvas-with-proposal-artifacts [pending]; event pipeline ownership (queue → worker → KV → /events) is SPINE:89-93 scope, untouched here — this proves the built client-side freshness loop only. The check needs at least one landable proposal in the demo set (demo recording requirement: all pending).

stories.title: Prove the single error surface, Retry now, and silent ticker degradation
stories.scope: Built degradation: platform/ui/app.js renderConnectionState (one red banner; 'Connection error: {msg}. Retrying...' / fallback 'Disconnected from platform worker. Retrying...'; Retry now re-fetches; hides on next success), loadEvents catch (silent: pulse is-stale, events retained, no banner), footer sync line (#last-sync-time 'not synced yet' → 'synced HH:MM:SS', never error-styled), renderHeader sync write. Evidence: instrumented real-UI run against a harness that fails /proposals once and /events always.
stories.acceptance: Every failed fetch except the ticker funnels into the one Connection banner: after a failed /proposals the banner shows exactly 'Connection error: {msg}. Retrying...' (fallback 'Disconnected from platform worker. Retrying...' when no message) with a 'Retry now' control, and it hides on the next success (retry click). Ticker failure degrades silently: pulse goes stale, ticker content is retained, no banner from the ticker, and the rest of the surface keeps rendering (cards present) while the ticker keeps polling. The footer sync line shows 'not synced yet' before any success and 'synced HH:MM:SS' after, and never carries error styling.
stories.notes: Overlaps build-multiplayer-triage-canvas-with-proposal-artifacts [pending] (canvas states) and inline-streaming-leak-deflectors-on-every-canvas-and-doc-wri [pending] (leak deflectors, not degradation) — build stays with those; this verifies the built failure surface. No rebuild.

stories.title: Prove the action banner state machine and card reset
stories.scope: Built action banner: platform/ui/app.js showActionBanner/hideActionBanner (warn 'landing' in flight; success 'landed' with commit; error 'failed'/'blocked'/'conflict'), single #action-banner element replaced per action, dismiss-only (#action-banner-close, no auto-hide timer anywhere), and handleLandProposal finally (state.landingRepo=null + renderProposals → card returns to default). Evidence: instrumented real-UI run against a harness whose /land fails once then succeeds.
stories.acceptance: A land attempt shows the warn in-flight banner ('landing', 'Landing proposal {repo} into {base}...') and the card's landing state; a failed land shows the error outcome (banner-error, badge 'failed') and returns the card to default (preview merge / Land into demo, no lingering confirm) in the same cycle; a following successful land shows success (banner-success, badge 'landed'). A new action replaces the previous banner in the single #action-banner element (count stays 1, class switches error→success); the banner is dismiss-only — it stays visible past the outcome until dismissed via its dismiss control, never auto-hiding.
stories.notes: Overlaps build-multiplayer-triage-canvas-with-proposal-artifacts [pending] (canvas action states); those rows own the build — this proves the built banner state machine, replacement semantics, dismiss-only behavior and card reset. Landing preconditions (stale/base-moved) hardening is SPINE:244 P0 work in a separate epic, not asserted here.

stories.title: Prove click-first actions with inline confirm and no dialogs
stories.scope: Built interaction model: platform/ui/app.js setupInteractions (click delegation; inline confirm states in renderProposals: is-confirming shows 'confirm land?' + 'cancel' buttons, cancel clears state.confirmingRepo without any request) and the source-level absence of dialogs/drag/context-menu/custom shortcuts (only Escape keydown). Evidence: instrumented real-UI run with window.confirm/alert/prompt instrumented + static source assertions on platform/ui/app.js.
stories.acceptance: Every action is a click/tap on a native control: card actions are real <button type=button> elements, no drag-based controls and no browser dialogs. Inline confirm replaces dialogs: clicking 'Land into demo' arms 'confirm land?' + 'cancel' in place with the modal still hidden; 'cancel' disarms back to the default actions and posts no /land request. Clicking through never invokes window.confirm/alert/prompt; app.js contains no confirm()/alert()/prompt() calls, no dragstart/dragover/drop/contextmenu/dblclick listeners, and the only keyboard branch is Escape (Tab/Enter/Space are native controls).
stories.notes: Overlaps build-multiplayer-triage-canvas-with-proposal-artifacts [pending] (canvas actions); build stays with those rows. This verifies the built click-first/interaction contract, no rebuild. Modal dismissal paths (Escape/backdrop/close) are covered by e1-verify-modal-dismissal-depth.

stories.title: Prove modal dismissal paths and one-level modal depth
stories.scope: Built modal behavior: platform/ui/app.js openModal/closeModal (single #inspector-modal element), setupInteractions (window keydown Escape closes; backdrop click e.target===modal closes; #btn-close-modal closes) and the merge-preview open path (handlePreviewMerge). Evidence: instrumented real-UI run against a fixture harness serving /merge.
stories.acceptance: Opening an inspector (preview merge) shows the modal with the right title ('Merge preview: {repo}'). Escape closes it; a backdrop click closes it; the close control closes it; each close leaves it reopenable. Modals stack one level deep: the document contains exactly one modal element at all times (no stacking wrapper), and opening another inspector replaces the content in that single modal in place (title switches to the newly opened repo).
stories.notes: Overlaps build-multiplayer-triage-canvas-with-proposal-artifacts [pending] and complete-unified-proposal-card-intent-diff-risk-provenance [pending] (inspector build); those rows own it — this proves the built dismissal paths and one-level depth. No rebuild.
